habitat: Original generic sedimentary rock teaching outcrop; no locality or age assignment
habitat_zh: 原创通用沉积岩教学露头，不指定产地或年代
claim_scope: Original stylized geological/mineral/process concept, not exact site reconstruction or a named organism.

reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: one continuous fine matrix body contains varied rounded pebbles. An original teaching fracture exposes differently sized sections, while curved outer surfaces retain partly embedded rounded relief and two small matrix recesses. Nominal 0.8 m width, muted mineral palette and layout are art choices; no exact deposition site, age, clast chemistry, grain count or process reconstruction. Closed clasts deliberately intersect the matrix, not a loose sphere pile; no source-media textures or copied rock mesh.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 地质形态艺术概念：单一连续细粒基质包含大小有变化的圆砾。原创教学破裂面露出不同尺寸剖切面，曲面外缘保留局部嵌入的圆润凸露，并有两处小基质凹隙。0.8米名义宽度、柔和矿物配色和排列为美术设定，不主张精确沉积地点、年代、砾石化学、颗粒计数或过程复原。封闭砾石有意嵌入基质，不是松散球堆；不使用来源图像贴图或复制岩石网格。
